thread:
alice: quick thought — our current error buckets are too coarse for tenant-level debugging. we can see '5xx' or 'quota' but not the why. proposing we evolve the error bucket taxonomy to include: client, retryable, terminal, quota_soft, quota_hard, degrade_fallback, model_mismatch, infra_timeout. this should feed both console badges and telemetry tags. :thinking:

ben: love the taxonomy names. +1 for distinguishing retryable vs terminal. SDKs need a deterministic mapping so customers can programmatically decide backoffs. suggest a small header for the SDKs: `X-Redwood-Err-Tag: retryable=1;bucket=quota_soft`

carmen: for console UX we need consistent short labels and color mapping. proposed mapping: client=gray, retryable=yellow, terminal=red, quota_soft=orange, quota_hard=red (with badge), degrade_fallback=purple, model_mismatch=blue. also we should expose a filter in the tenant dashboard "Show Retryable" and "Show Fallbacks".

oliver: backward-compat concern: older clients expect only HTTP codes. we should not change status codes, only augment with structured metadata in a response header / body field. also need to ensure sampling doesn't drop rare buckets like model_mismatch.

maya: rollout plan: start with telemetry-only (tagging in APM/traces) at 5% of traffic for 48h, verify cardinality and cost, then wire console filters in canary orgs, then SDK surface. sampling rules: always keep full fidelity for tenant admins, and 0.5% global sampling for anonymous aggregates.

ben: re: SDK mapping — propose library returns an error object with `kind` and `bucket` fields, e.g. { kind: 'retryable', bucket: 'quota_soft', subcode: 'overrate' }. that keeps status code semantics intact but is machine-readable.

alice: example response snippet we could standardize (server-side):
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
X-Redwood-Error-Tags: bucket=quota_soft;retryable=true;subcode=burst_limit
{
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "message": "tenant budget exceeded; soft throttle applied",
  "meta": { "bucket": "quota_soft", "retryable": true }
}
```

oliver: minor nit — prefer `X-Redwood-Error-Tags` name to be stable. also let's include `error.bucket` as an event tag in traces and metrics to allow aggregation.

carmen: console needs a migration fallback: older dashboards should show an "unclassified" bucket when no tag present. new orgs get full labels. also add runbook links per bucket (hover -> short help + remediation).

maya: ops/rollout note: we'll need a short-lived feature flag to flip tag emission per cluster. deploy-bot: starting canary deploy for tagging feature in infra-qa at 1754242438.

deploy-bot: deploy  infra/tagging-feature v1 -> infra-qa succeeded (1754242440) :white_check_mark:

ben: action items I see: 1) runtime emits `X-Redwood-Error-Tags` with agreed keys, 2) telemetry team maps `error.bucket` -> metrics/trace tag, 3) console team builds filters + badge color palette, 4) SDK teams add `kind`/`bucket` in error objects.

alice: agreed. i'll write a tiny RFC with the proposed bucket list, header schema, and rollout plan. tagging owners: @ben (SDK), @carmen (console), @maya (telemetry/rollout), @oliver (compat). aiming to start RFC review tomorrow. :+1:

carmen: also sending a quick mock of the filter UI in #design after lunch.

ben: i'll PR the SDK shape and a migration guide for customers.

maya: i'll coordinate the sampling policy and set the 5% canary flag.

alice: thanks everyone — will ping when RFC link is up.
